finding: A nominally clean pinned worktree can contain an altered tracked source hidden by Git assume-unchanged, or an ignored Python import-shadow module under scripts/. Pre-existing git diff and untracked checks accepted both in an isolated real-Git reproduction.
fix: Compare the 11 declared source paths and this orchestrator bytewise through git hash-object against HEAD:path blobs. Reject ignored paths under scripts/ and spray_schema/ in addition to already-denied visible untracked files. Fail closed before launching Chromium.

isolated_reproduction.git_behavior: Real ephemeral Git repositories with pinned commits, git update-index --assume-unchanged, and .git/info/exclude
isolated_reproduction.scope: Reproduction of exact preflight Git predicates only; not GitHub original module/unit test execution

limitations: Container has no full authorized private SPRAY checkout, so native repository tests and current HEAD original Chromium/G5 pipeline were not run.
